name: Malletgreave
description: Open the exchange with the head grounded and the haft slanted so the first cut is taken on wood.

name: Blazequake
description: Let an attacker's blow slide past and drop the head like an anvil onto the exposed shoulder.

name: Mayhem Ironband
description: Hook the butt of the haft behind the opponent's ankle and jerk it to spoil their step.

name: Endcappounce
description: Slide the lead foot far forward as the haft extends to strike from the edge of reach.

name: Might Heavyhelve
description: Send blow after blow down upon a guard with qi surging through the arms in rolling waves.

name: Chime Gripbulge
description: Wedge the shoulder and haft into the chest and burst qi outward to hurl the opponent back.

name: Wedgeface Greave
description: Whirl the haft in a fast circle before the body so that every incoming point is thrown wide.

name: Mightsquash
description: Rise to full height and bring the qi-laden head down on the crown of the opponent in one fall.

name: Slag Sledgeface
description: Slam the head into the ground so that a shock runs through the earth and knocks nearby feet from under them.

name: Hoarfrost Mallethead
description: Stand with the head cocked at the shoulder and the weight forward so any opening is answered at once.

name: Iron Sledge
description: Bring the maul over in a long heavy arc that rolls through a guard like a breaking wave.

name: Blaze Maulbutt
description: Sweep the head low from the side and crush the joint of the leading knee.

name: Mayhem Flatten
description: Stop a charging opponent with the level haft against the chest and shove them back a pace.

name: Thudjaunt
description: Break the rhythm of the advance with a half step and a pause so the opponent misjudges the distance.

name: Might Quake
description: Keep striking the same point of a guard while qi builds in the head until the guard breaks.

name: Granite Endcap
description: Use the head's bounce off one target to carry it straight into the next with a pulse of qi.

name: Heavyhelve Greave
description: Wrap the haft in a shell of qi and hold it before the body against a flurry of cuts.

name: Facetsquash
description: Read the weakest point of a guard or plate and drop the narrow face upon it with concentrated qi.

name: Squash Maelstrom
description: Smash the head into the paving so cracks race outward and heave the ground under every foot.

name: Thorn Maulhead
description: Walk forward with the haft angled across the body so cuts land on wood and not on flesh.

name: Rumble Ironband
description: Take a step that pushes the enemy's weapon aside then drop the head on the opened line.

name: Toxin Thud
description: Brace the head against the opponent's shield and shove with the legs to stop their advance.

name: Gust Pommelweight
description: Meet a blade on the flat side of the head and turn it off the line of the body.

name: Mightmallet
description: Strike repeatedly while pressing forward and keep qi in the haft so each guard doubles as a blow.

name: Tempered Sledge
description: Knock an enemy parry open with a short qi burst and land the head through the gap before it closes.

name: Rumble Endcap
description: Charge through a counter-cut and bring the head down with the full weight of the advance behind it.

name: Gust Quake
description: Roll the maul around the body in a continuous guard while qi carries the feet through a full circle.

name: Subduing Pommelweight
description: Drive the shoulder into the front of a shield line to rock the whole rank on its heels.

name: Skinning Maulbutt
description: Sweep the head flat through a hedge of leveled spear shafts and snap them off.

name: Trouncing Pulverize
description: Hammer down onto the leading soldier of a rank so that the man behind must step over him.

name: Gust Sledgeface
description: Rap the head down on the rim of a raised shield until the arm holding it gives.

name: Facet Maulhead
description: Hold the haft upright in both fists inside a press of bodies to turn aside nearby blades.

name: Gustendcap
description: Step sideways into the space a broken file leaves between two enemy soldiers.

name: Rumbledolly
description: Bring the narrow face onto the seam of a wooden shield with qi until the boards split.

name: Gust Mallethead
description: Swing through the front rank again and again with qi held at the shoulders until the rank has thinned.

name: Toxinbeetle
description: Catch a set pike point on the haft and burst qi to throw its bearer backward into his fellows.

name: Tempered Pulverize
description: Leap into the pike hedge and bring the head down on the shield and the body behind it at once.

name: Thud Assault
description: Stamp and swing without pause through the broken line so that every step shakes the ground and drops those nearby.

name: Tempered Gripbulge
description: Swing the head along one track while the haft covers the second so the first blow leaves a twin ready.

name: Sledgeface Fastness
description: Hold the haft with two spread hands and turn both ends outward to guard two sides at once.

name: Silt Squash
description: Step around the opponent in a shallow curve like the rim of a bowl with the head trailing low.

name: Chime Pommelweight
description: Strike the opponent's forearm with the butt of the haft as if skipping a stone across water.

name: Endcapthrash
description: Strike in pairs of blows with a held breath between each pair and qi pooling in the wrists.

name: Blazebeetle
description: Cross the feet to slip a cut and strike with the head from the unexpected side.

name: Unshaken Heavyhelve
description: Meet two attacks together by turning the haft one way then the other in a single pass.

name: Splitting Wedgeface Maelstrom
description: Drop the head on one track then reverse it along the second before the opponent can answer the first.

name: Tearing Maulbutt
description: Slam the head down so a shock rings across the floor and rebounds from the walls of the hall.

name: Iron Maulhead
description: Perch the head high on one shoulder with the haft angled down as a guard against low cuts.

name: Trouncing Thud
description: Drop from a high stance onto the target with the head leading like a hawk stooping on prey.

name: Glintthud
description: Jab the butt and then the cap of the haft in two quick thrusts at the ribs.

name: Blurring Pulverize
description: Beat out a pair of quick steps like wings opening to hop clear of a low sweep.

name: Restoring Mallethead
description: Hold still for one breath with the head raised and mark the opening before committing the blow.

name: Might Gripbulge
description: Dive with the head and climb back up on the rebound while qi runs through both arms.

name: Rumblethud
description: Catch a weapon between the head and haft and twist with a flick of qi to rip it free.

name: Gust Wedgeface
description: Spread both arms and sweep the maul in a wide wing to bat a thrust upward.

name: Tearing Quake
description: Leap high and plunge with the maul head first so the whole weight of the dive lands on the target.

name: Ironsquash
description: Gather qi at the top of the lift then release two heavy blows one upon the other.

name: Pommelweight Fastness
description: Plant the feet wide as if wading and hold the haft crosswise to catch every cut at the ford.

name: Squash Cuirass
description: Push the haft out with both arms and lean so that a crowd presses back like a current meeting a post.

name: Might Flatten
description: Drop the head as heavily as a bank stone rolling into water onto the first man across.

name: Gustdolly
description: Shift from one firm footing to the next in short hops so the stance never gives way.

name: Drubbing Sledge
description: Surge forward with qi held steady and hammer at whoever stands in the path of the crossing.

name: Chime Maulhead
description: Turn on the heel so the haft sweeps a thrust into a slow circle and away.

name: Tearing Heavyhelve
description: Let the full weight of the body and the gathered qi fall through the head like a flood.

name: Tempered Sledgeface
description: Pour a cascade of overhead blows onto one narrow front while qi streams through the shoulders.

name: Mallethauberk
description: Face into the wind with the head low and the haft slanted so every cut lands on wood.

name: Sanguine Maulbutt
description: Bring the head down at the last step before the edge of the ground so the blow carries the whole drop.

name: Might Ironband
description: Lean into the wind and let the head sweep low across the shins at the wind's pace.

name: Lancing Endcap
description: Fix a bearing on the target and drive the haft butt straight along it without deviation.

name: Sledge Sprint
description: Set each foot down firmly like a sworn stone so that no gust can shift the stance.

name: Staggering Wedgeface
description: Rap the haft across the wrists from the windward side so the opponent's weapon veers off.

name: Quaketorment
description: Climb through a chain of strokes each stronger than the last while qi swells with the wind.

name: Murk Mallethead
description: Hold the haft on its bearing and let attacks slide off to the lee side.

name: Tempered Flatten
description: Step out with a gust at the shoulder and bring the head down on the attacker's flank.

name: Rumblesledge
description: Shove the broad poll into the opponent's chest and burst qi to send them skidding across bare ground.

name: Scalding Pulverize
description: Leap on a rising gust and plunge the maul down with wind and qi both behind it.

name: Needling Gripbulge
description: Break the bare ground with one blow so shards of earth fly and the footing of those near is lost.

name: Maulbutt Cloak
description: Hold the haft on the sworn bearing and take every cut on its length without turning.

name: Ironendcap
description: Raise and drop the head along one fixed bearing so the blow travels as straight as a sworn word.

name: Squash Pounce
description: Move along the sworn line in short even steps and never let the heels cross it.

name: Anointing Maulhead
description: Tap the poll and feel the wind along the haft to learn which way the bearing must be set.

name: Sanguine Ironband
description: Speak the rite in three drops of the head with qi rising through the arms on each count.

name: Rumble Flatten
description: Catch the opponent's weapon on the haft and wrench it off its own bearing with a burst of qi.

name: Equipoise Pommelweight
description: Beat aside a heavy cut with the haft as a gale beats down tall grass.

name: Sanguine Sledge
description: Hold the bearing to the last instant and then bring the qi-laden head down on the sworn mark.

name: Siltmallet
description: Strike the ground on the bearing so the shock runs along the line and drops all who stand on it.

name: Beetlegreave
description: Carry the maul on the shoulder against the wind with the haft slanted forward as a guard.

name: Malletassault
description: Drive the head down into the teeth of the wind so the resistance sets the heavy tempo.

name: Endcap Assault
description: Roll the head on the back of the wind and cut across the target faster than they expect.

name: Drubbing Quake
description: Slip to the sheltered side of the opponent and jab the haft end into the kidney.

name: Wedgeface Spurt
description: Shuffle sideways across the wind so it pushes the body toward the target and not away.

name: Gust Heavyhelve
description: Advance one slow stride at a time and drop the head upon each stride with qi unbroken.

name: Annealed Gripbulge
description: Catch a thrust on the broad head as the gust hits and fling it out of line.

name: Hamstringing Sledgeface
description: Pin an enemy weapon down with the head and lever it from the hand as the wind shoves.

name: Squashthrash
description: Throw the maul down with the whole push of the gale and a charge of qi in the head.

name: Scalding Ironband
description: Advance at the pace of a rising storm striking every few steps while qi streams through the whole body.
